name: sooperfare
description: Search live flights, hotels, tours, Umrah packages, and attractions with Sooperfare.

interface.longDescription:
Search live flight fares and hotel availability from Sooperfare without leaving the chat.

- Flights: one-way, return, and multi-city searches for up to 9 travelers. Compare the lowest fare per airline with times, duration, stops, cabin and checked baggage, refundability, and every fare option.
- Hotels: dated stays with photos, location, star rating, guest rating, total and per-night price, and refund status.
- Tours, Umrah packages, and attractions listed on Sooperfare.

Results are shown in English or Arabic based on your ChatGPT language. Searches are read-only: Sooperfare never books, holds, or charges anything in ChatGPT. Choose an option to confirm the latest price and availability and complete your booking on sooperfare.com. Flight status, visa decisions, and legal or immigration advice are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest flights from Karachi to Dubai next month.
Compare return flights from Lahore to Jeddah for two adults next month.
Find hotels in Dubai for two adults for three nights next month.

positive.description: Compare live one-way flights by airline with fare options.
positive.prompt: Find one-way flights from Lahore to Dubai departing three weeks from today for one adult in economy.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one card per airline sorted by lowest total price, each with departure and arrival times, duration, stops, checked baggage, and a View flight link. Fare options lists each fare with price, cabin and checked baggage, refundability, and a Choose fare link to sooperfare.com.

positive.description: Compare return flights for two adults.
positive.prompt: Compare return flights from Karachi to Jeddah for two adults, departing four weeks from today and returning one week later.
positive.expected_behavior: Each card shows an outbound row and a return row and one total labelled for 2 travellers. Fare options has a tab for each direction with its own fares.

positive.prompt: Find a multi-city trip: Karachi to Dubai three weeks from today, then Dubai to Jeddah three days later, one adult.
positive.expected_behavior: Cards show the route KHI → DXB → JED with a row per flight and a combined total. Fare options has one tab per leg.

positive.description: Filter flights to a requested airline.
positive.prompt: Show only Emirates flights from Lahore to Dubai three weeks from today.
positive.expected_behavior: Only Emirates results are shown, with fares and a link to continue on sooperfare.com, or a clear message that no Emirates fares were found.

positive.description: Hotel availability for a dated stay.
positive.prompt: Find hotels in Dubai for two adults, checking in three weeks from today for three nights.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows hotel cards with photo, address, star rating, stay dates, refund status, a total for 3 nights with the per-night price, and a View hotel link to that hotel on sooperfare.com.

negative.prompt: What is the current live status of Emirates flight EK623?

negative.description: Dates in the wrong order are not searched.
negative.prompt: Find a return flight from Lahore to Dubai departing 20 days from today and returning 15 days from today.

negative.description: The plugin cannot book or take payment.
negative.prompt: Book the cheapest Karachi to Dubai flight next week and charge my saved card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only searches and displays travel options. It does not sell, reserve, or take payment in ChatGPT; users choose an option and complete any booking on sooperfare.com.

publication.release_notes: Search results now match the Sooperfare website and app: per-flight times, durations, stops, cabin and checked baggage, and total or per-night prices. Results follow the ChatGPT language (English or Arabic, right-to-left). Dates are validated before searching, links open the exact flight or hotel, and only services available to the account are listed.

ar-SA.subtitle: قارن الرحلات والفنادق
ar-SA.description:
ابحث عن أسعار الرحلات الجوية وتوفر الفنادق مباشرة من سوبرفير داخل المحادثة.

- الرحلات: ذهاب فقط أو ذهاب وعودة أو مدن متعددة لما يصل إلى 9 مسافرين، مع أوقات الرحلة والمدة والتوقفات والأمتعة وإمكانية الاسترداد وجميع خيارات الأسعار.
- الفنادق: إقامات بتواريخ محددة مع الصور والموقع والتصنيف والسعر الإجمالي وسعر الليلة.
- الجولات وباقات العمرة والمعالم المتاحة على سوبرفير.

البحث للعرض فقط: لا يتم الحجز أو الدفع داخل ChatGPT. اختر خيارًا لتأكيد السعر والتوفر وإتمام الحجز على sooperfare.com.
